purpose: Validate ISO 42005-style AI impact-assessment completeness across seven required elements: intended use, affected stakeholders (>=1), risk treatment definition, monitoring plan, formal approval, risk category identification (>=1), and data source documentation. Returns completeness_score (0-100) and gaps list. Feeds system governance classifier (art-173). Zero network, zero PII. ISO/IEC 42005.
